title: Planting when the meal is due
explanation: The joke is a mismatch between a long preparation and an immediate need. Planting a crop when the occasion has arrived cannot supply that occasion’s meal. The saying criticises starting essential work too late, rather than the act of planting itself.
meaning_odia: ବାହାଘରର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଆସିଲାଣି, ଅଥଚ ବାଇଗଣ ଚାରା ଲଗାଇବାର ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଏବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଫଳ ମିଳିବାକୁ ସମୟ ଲାଗୁଥିବା କାମକୁ ଶେଷ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପକାଇରଖିବା ହିଁ ଏଠାରେ ହାସ୍ୟର କାରଣ। କଥାଟି ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତିର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବୁଝାଏ, ସବୁ ବାହାଘରର ଖାଦ୍ୟତାଲିକା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: The event starts tomorrow, but the organisers only now begin looking for a venue. Someone compares their timing to planting eggplant at wedding time. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The wedding and vegetable crop create the contrast. This does not prove eggplant is required at every Odia wedding or identify a particular community’s menu. The graphic illustrates lead time, not an agricultural timetable.

odia_summary: ଦରକାର ବେଳ ଆସିଗଲା ପରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା।
english_summary: The occasion has arrived, but the preparation that should have begun long ago is only starting.
